summary: The Pentagon continued its document releases this week, dropping a fifth tranche of UFO files that included accounts of "black triangle" sightings, while Senator Marco Rubio reiterated the need to resolve the UAP mystery during a public appearance. An intelligence watchdog reportedly warned of a potential FBI referral over alleged disclosure of UAP whistleblower testimony, adding to concerns about how sensitive information is being handled within government channels. Separately, investigative journalist Ross Coulthart released several Q&A segments addressing claims about covert programs, the Skywatcher satellite, and phenomena reported at Skinwalker Ranch, keeping public attention on what he frames as hidden government activities. The week saw no new congressional legislation introduced, though discussion about whether the Trump administration is operating undisclosed UAP programs continued in media coverage. Combined, these developments suggest ongoing tension between official disclosure efforts and allegations that classified UAP-related work remains deliberately hidden from public view.
